title: When Are Predictions Enough? An Evaluation Protocol for Frozen Expert Composition
abstract: arXiv:2611.13356v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Practitioners often combine independently trained models while keeping their weights frozen. These experts are commonly combined through their final predictions, although their internal features may retain useful information that those predictions omit. We ask when combining features improves on combining predictions, and how to make that comparison fair. We introduce a reusable evaluation protocol, apply it to 21 frozen deepfake detectors from DF40 (Yan et al., 2024), and audit how evaluation choices change the conclusions. The protocol uses strong prediction baselines, compares simple and larger feature combiners, varies architecture and training data separately, and reports results by held-out generator with train/test overlap controls. Under leave-one-generator-out evaluation, logistic regression on the features of six architecture-diverse experts improves macro AUROC by 0.081 over the best tested prediction combiner in each fold,

translated_title: 何时仅凭预测就够了？一种冻结专家组合的评估协议
translated_abstract: 实践者常常在保持模型权重冻结的情况下组合独立训练的模型。这些专家模型通常通过其最终预测结果进行组合，然而它们的内部特征可能保留了那些预测结果所忽略的有用信息。我们探讨了何时组合特征会优于组合预测，以及如何使这种比较公平。我们提出了一个可复用的评估协议，将其应用于来自 DF40（Yan et al., 2024）的 21 个冻结深度伪造检测器，并审查了评估选择如何改变结论。该协议采用强大的预测基线，比较简单与更大规模的特征组合器，分别独立地变化架构与训练数据，并通过留出生成器以及训练/测试重叠控制来报告结果。在留一生成器评估下，对六个架构多样的专家模型特征进行逻辑回归，在每一折中都比测试过的最佳预测组合器将宏平均 AUROC 提升了 0.081。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个可复用的评估协议来公平比较冻结专家模型的特征组合与预测组合，并发现对六个架构多样的深度伪造检测专家特征进行逻辑回归，在留一生成器评估中比最佳预测组合器的宏平均 AUROC 提升 0.081。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a reusable evaluation protocol for fairly comparing frozen expert composition via features versus predictions, showing that logistic regression over features from six architecture-diverse deepfake detection experts improves macro AUROC by 0.081 over the best prediction combiner under leave-one-generator-out evaluation.
